div.div:
Changed since the July diagram (langgraph_pipeline_before_2026-07.drawio.svg)
1. reveal node added: the run pauses until the child accepts the references; "try again" redraws them, at most 3 times.
2. char_ref_mod can send a flagged reference back to char_bible for one redraw (MAX_MOD_REDRAWS = 1).
3. regenerate returns to consistency_check, not generate_scene; the better of the two attempts is kept.
4. Output moderation runs on each page as soon as it is final, inside the loop (2026-08-13), not once at the end.
5. route_next_scene decides what happens next: draw a page, screen a page, or compose.

text.tspan: 1. reveal node added: the run pauses until the child accepts the references; "try again" redraws them, at most 3 times.
2. char_ref_mod can send a flagged reference back to char_bible for one redraw (MAX_MOD_REDRAWS = 1).
3. regenerate returns to consistency_check, not generate_scene; the better of the two attempts is kept.
4. Output moderation runs on each page as soon as it is final, inside the loop (2026-08-13), not once at the end.
5. route_next_scene decides what happens next: draw a page, screen a page, or compose.
